items.markdown:
![Curb Link Chain Necklace - Lightweight - 14K Yellow and White ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09290840-2330-0066-0000-e8ef6687a6bd:15)
Chain necklaces come in many distinct styles, each defined by how its metal links are shaped, connected, and worn.[[1]](https://icecartel.com/blogs/news/types-of-chain-necklaces)

### Most Popular Chain Types

- **Cable Chain:** Features simple, uniform round or oval interlocking links. It is a minimalist, classic choice that works well for everyday wear and pendants.[[1]](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/fashion/types-of-chains)[[2]](https://jamesmichelle.com/blogs/news/types-of-chain-styles)[[3]](https://icecartel.com/blogs/news/types-of-chain-necklaces)
- **Curb Chain:** Composed of symmetrical, twisted links that have been flattened so the entire chain lies completely flush against the skin.[[1]](https://www.mygemologist.com/learn/general-info/types-of-necklace-chains/)[[2]](https://jamesmichelle.com/blogs/news/types-of-chain-styles)
- **Cuban Link Chain:** A heavy, tightly interlocking variant of the curb chain with a thicker, bolder profile. It is a staple statement style in modern fashion and hip-hop.[[1]](https://jamesmichelle.com/blogs/news/types-of-chain-styles)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uh7PR5FYOGE)[[3]](https://icecartel.com/blogs/news/types-of-chain-necklaces)
- **Box Chain:** Built using interconnected square or Venetian links that form a smooth, geometric, and sturdy profile.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uh7PR5FYOGE)[[2]](https://icecartel.com/blogs/news/types-of-chain-necklaces)
- **Rope Chain:** Made from small, twisted metal segments woven together to resemble the spiral pattern of a real nautical rope. It catches the light heavily and offers great durability.[[1]](https://lukezionjewelry.com/blogs/news/types-of-chains)[[2]](https://jamesmichelle.com/blogs/news/types-of-chain-styles)
- **Figaro Chain:** Features a repeating pattern of alternating links—typically one elongated, flattened oval link followed by two to three smaller circular links.[[1]](https://icecartel.com/blogs/news/types-of-chain-necklaces)
- **Herringbone Chain:** Formed by rows of rigid, V-shaped metallic links that lie flat to create a silky, liquid-metal, mirror-like finish.[[1]](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/fashion/types-of-chains)
- **Wheat (Spiga) Chain:** Constructed from four strands of twisted oval links braided together to mimic the appearance of a stalk of wheat. It offers rich texture while remaining flexible.[[1]](https://www.marketsquarejewelers.com/blogs/msj-handbook/the-big-guide-to-chain-types)[[2]](https://icecartel.com/blogs/news/types-of-chain-necklaces)[[3]](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/fashion/types-of-chains)
- **Snake Chain:** Utilizes tightly packed, smooth plates or bands shaped like rings to form a flexible, scaled tube that hugs the neck.[[1]](https://www.marketsquarejewelers.com/blogs/msj-handbook/the-big-guide-to-chain-types)[[2]](https://icecartel.com/blogs/news/types-of-chain-necklaces)

You can read more detailed breakdowns of styles and durability in guides from [Blue Nile](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/fashion/types-of-chains) or [Market Square Jewelers](https://www.marketsquarejewelers.com/blogs/msj-handbook/the-big-guide-to-chain-types?srsltid=AU7gw4WCmWpi3Ui9XE-jYo-ehamyGYQeYg6YYrvqp0WEkujiYY9zEhmD).[[1]](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/fashion/types-of-chains)[[2]](https://www.marketsquarejewelers.com/blogs/msj-handbook/the-big-guide-to-chain-types)If you'd like, let me know:

- **How you plan to wear it** (alone or with a pendant)
- Your preferred **metal type** (gold, silver, or stainless steel)
- Your style **vibe** (delicate for layering or a bold statement piece)

I can help you pick the best chain for your needs.
